title: Spotlight: Delhi High Court Justice Tejas Karia
description: Spotlight is a series where we shine the, well, spotlight on members of the legal fraternity who made the news over the past week.Telegram's challenge to the Central government's decision to temporarily ban it in India put the spotlight on the Delhi High Court judge who heard the matter this past week - Justice Tejas Karia.
